posts.title: are we sick of politics? or politicians? or both?
posts.description: Radio NZ has an article today headlined Are New Zealanders sick of politics- or sick of politicians? . posts.title: on Wayne Brown's escapades
posts.description: I do not know Wayne Brown personally. I do not live in Auckland. I have no particular interest or investment in Wayne Brown's actions as mayor of Auckland. I can only write about Wayne Brown as the character who appears in the news as Mayor of Auckland, and my opinion of him is based purely on that. I may well have completely misread the man.
